quarantined_leads.subject_response: The School Board said the agreement brings the litigation to a close and that it remains committed to Virginia law, transparency, accountability, and responsible governance; it did not disclose settlement terms or comment further. The article states the case ended without a court ruling that the Board or any individual member violated Virginia law.

The panel must determine, if possible, whether Burton engaged in a pattern of misconduct and evaluate the accuracy of her testing, analysis, and testimony.
